name: en_to_es_noun
description: Translate short English sentence into Spanish; answer is Spanish noun after the article. Control: reverse direction (Spanish->English), English noun.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
nouns=[("house","casa","la"),("table","mesa","la"),("car","coche","el"),("door","puerta","la"),("window","ventana","la"),("book","libro","el"),("garden","jardín","el"),("kitchen","cocina","la"),("city","ciudad","la"),("street","calle","la"),("school","escuela","la"),("church","iglesia","la"),("forest","bosque","el"),("river","río","el"),("bed","cama","la"),("box","caja","la"),("bag","bolsa","la"),("tree","árbol","el"),("room","habitación","la"),("market","mercado","el"),("train","tren","el"),("boat","barco","el"),("park","parque","el"),("office","oficina","la"),("village","pueblo","el"),("bottle","botella","la"),("shop","tienda","la"),("field","campo","el"),("castle","castillo","el"),("library","biblioteca","la")]
subj=[("The dog","El perro"),("The cat","El gato"),("My brother","Mi hermano"),("The child","El niño"),("The teacher","El profesor"),("My mother","Mi madre")]
preps=[("is in","está en"),("is near","está cerca de"),("is behind","está detrás de"),("is under","está debajo de"),("sleeps in","duerme en"),("waits behind","espera detrás de")]
items=[];ctrl=[];seen=set()
while len(items)<120:
    n=random.choice(nouns);s=random.choice(subj);p=random.choice(preps)
    key=(n[0],s[0],p[0])
    if key in seen: continue
    seen.add(key)
    art=n[2]
    pp=p[1]
    if art=="el" and pp.endswith(" de"):
        pre=f"{s[1]} {pp[:-3]} del"
    else:
        pre=f"{s[1]} {pp} {art}"
    en=f"{s[0]} {p[0]} the {n[0]}."
    items.append({"prompt":f"English: {en}\nSpanish: {pre}","answer":" "+n[1]})
    ctrl.append({"prompt":f"Spanish: {pre} {n[1]}.\nEnglish: {s[0]} {p[0]} the","answer":" "+n[0]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":ctrl},open('/work/skill.json','w'),ensure_ascii=False)
